name: La Mojonera (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and navy blue, charged on the white with the crowned municipal arms of La Mojonera (a sun on blue within a border inscribed 10 DE ABRIL DE 1984).
history: Municipal flag of La Mojonera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: La Mojonera arms — sun on blue with inscribed border
